# Bagaholic

> > Bagaholic is a luxury resale marketplace specializing in pre-owned and refurbished Louis Vuitton handbags, wallets, and accessories, with select pieces from Chanel, Gucci, Givenchy, and Celine.

The site focuses primarily on authenticated Louis Vuitton products across iconic collections including Monogram Canvas, Damier Ebene, Damier Azur, Vernis, and limited edition pieces. Bagaholic offers flexible payment plans and ships luxury items worldwide, with particular emphasis on rare collectible bags and exotic leather pieces.
